purpose: Free-only model assignments for ModForge coordination and OpenCode support work.
swap_rule: Change the primary_model or fallback_model for a role here, then keep .modforge/agents.json model_profile references unchanged.
catalog_source: OpenCode free catalog only; Go subscription models are defined separately in opencode.go.json and are never selected by this catalog.

boss.reason: General coordination, prioritization, routing, and handoff quality.

planner.reason: Planning, decomposition, checklists, and acceptance wording.

grunt.reason: Fast lookups, scoping, cleanup, and evidence collection.

qa_reviewer.reason: Independent review, risk spotting, and evidence-bound judgment.

researcher.reason: Narrow technical and compatibility research with low routine cost.
